# qualys_auth_record_unix (Resource)

A Qualys Unix/Linux (SSH) authentication record.

Authenticated scans find materially more than unauthenticated ones. Credentials
supplied here are write-only — see below.

~> Qualys creates **Cisco IOS and Checkpoint Firewall** records through this same
`unix` endpoint rather than giving them their own. Use this resource for those
technologies too.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "qualys_vaults" "cyberark" {
  title = "corp-cyberark"
}

resource "qualys_auth_record_unix" "linux_fleet" {
  title    = "linux-fleet"
  username = "qualys-scanner"

  vault_id   = one([for v in data.qualys_vaults.cyberark.vaults : v.id])
  vault_type = "CyberArk AIM"

  ips = ["10.20.0.0/24"]
}
```

## Credentials are write-only

`password` is sent to Qualys and never read back. Consequences worth knowing:

- A password changed outside Terraform is **not** detected as drift.
- The value still lives in Terraform state, because Terraform stores what you
  configured. Protect state accordingly.

`vault_id` avoids both problems: Qualys fetches the credential from the vault at
scan time, and the secret never passes through Terraform at all. Prefer it where
the subscription has a vault configured.

Exactly one of `password` or `vault_id` must be set. A record with neither is
accepted by Qualys, but scans using it fall back to unauthenticated and report
far less — so the provider rejects it at plan time.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- **title** (String) Name of the authentication record.
- **username** (String) Account the scanner authenticates as.

### Optional

- **comments** (String)
- **id** (String) The ID of this resource.
- **ips** (Set of String) Hosts this record applies to.
- **password** (String, Sensitive) Password for the account. Conflicts with `vault_id`.
- **vault_id** (String) ID of a configured Qualys vault. Conflicts with `password`.
- **vault_type** (String) Type of the referenced vault. Required with `vault_id`.

### Read-Only

- **created** (String)
- **modified** (String)

## Import

```shell
terraform import qualys_auth_record_unix.linux_fleet 123456
```
